high_level_description: stc brand style, a middle-aged couple sharing a meal in a modern kitchen.

compositional_deconstruction.background: A modern kitchen with white curtains, a curved faucet, and soft natural lighting creating a warm domestic atmosphere.

elements.desc: A middle-aged man wearing a white long-sleeved shirt, seated at a white table eating from a plate.
A woman wearing a white hijab and a patterned purple and white dress, standing at the kitchen counter.
Multiple plates of food on the table, including fried items, a glass of water, a woven basket, and a glass container with yellow liquid.
